text: Comparing critiqued revisions with direct revisions, the paper reports that critiqued revisions achieve better harmlessness preference-model scores for small models but make no noticeable difference for large models; inspecting 52B samples, the authors found the critiques were sometimes reasonable but often made inaccurate or overstated criticisms, although revisions were generally more harmless than the original response.
title: Self-critique before revision helps small models; 52B critiques often inaccurate
